source.title: RRB Centralised Employment Notice CEN No. 06/2026, Non-Technical Popular Categories (Graduate)

review_notes: published_on = date of the indicative notice in Employment News (the detailed CEN states no other date). The notice states no section order: sections_in_fixed_order is false. The 120-minute duration applies only to eligible PwBD candidates with a scribe; mocks use the standard 90 minutes.
